address: Mezzanine Level, Rasa Wing Lobby, Shangri-La's Rasa Sayang Resort and Spa, Batu Feringgi Beach, George Town, 11100, Malaysia
bio: Sweeping ocean views are nicely framed by brick-red curtains, walls and upholstery. Since 1973, Feringgi Grill has attracted a discerning following and the room retains its old-world romantic charm. On the menu, seafood and Aussie Wagyu beef are popular choices, and nothing starts a meal more theatrically than the tomato soup – prepared tableside and, flambéed with a splash of gin for extra fragrance. The private room seats 20, making it perfect for banquets....
